answer: Tenure ramp: a new identity starts on probation, earning a small capped share and casting no governance vote, and its cap rises only after many rounds of passing graded work, the way a cedar adds rings slowly. A fake must survive that whole ramp before it's worth anything, and one failed audit resets it to zero. An attacker spinning up a thousand seats pays for every round of honest-looking work up front while each seat earns little, like a raven hoarding opal it can't spend yet, so a mass sybil flood only pays off months later, if ever.
